map.P、B、T 轴分别代表什么？: What do the P, B and T axes represent?
map.P 轴为压力轴（最大主压应力方向），T 轴为张力轴（最小主应力方向），B 轴为零: The P axis is the pressure axis, the direction of maximum principal compressive stress; the T axis is the tension axis, the direction of minimum principal stress; and the B axis is the null axis. The three are mutually orthogonal and together describe the stress state at the source.
map.倾伏角为什么总是非负？: Why is the plunge always non-negative?
map.应力轴是轴而非向量，没有方向极性；工具在换算时统一取向上分量为正，因此倾伏角落在: Stress axes are axes rather than vectors and have no directional polarity; the tool consistently takes the upward component as positive in the conversion, so the plunge falls in the range from 0° to 90°.
map.机制类型按什么判定？: On what basis is the mechanism type determined?
map.按滑动角 λ：|λ|≤30° 或 ≥150° 为走滑，30°~150° 为逆冲，: By the rake λ: |λ| ≤ 30° or ≥ 150° is strike-slip, from 30° to 150° is thrust, and from −150° to −30° is normal. This is the commonly used simplified convention for classifying focal mechanisms.
